versions.changelog:
yq-pdf-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Converts any HTML content (web links, presentations, HTML files) to PDF via browser print (Ctrl+P).
- Deploys provided HTML (with print styles) to a persistent link for user access and export.
- Clear instructions returned to users for exporting PDF, ensuring proper appearance (e.g., dark backgrounds).
- Only supports HTML-to-PDF; direct image/other file uploads to CDN are not supported by this skill.
